body.text: I must ask you to move me out of {param:town}.
I will not dress it up. The mood here has turned and the watch is thin, and a man who writes to London every month is not a popular figure in a town of that temper.
{param:to} would answer. The passage and the setting up would come to {param:amount}.

You should know what it costs you as well as what it costs the Crown. I will be two months at sea and writing nothing, and what I can tell you about this place I will stop being able to tell you about it.
I would rather not put it more plainly than that. I think you can see what I am not saying.

tone.text: On the matter of your posting, I am {choice}.

options.text: glad you wrote and quick to answer

options.label: move him
options.text: Go to {param:to}. The Crown will meet the cost of it.

options.label: he stays where he is
options.text: You will remain where you are. I need eyes in that town more than you need a quiet one.
